text:
Iris Valdez: Quick QA — ghost/secondary CTAs in the Resource table look vertically misaligned with icon buttons in the same row. also toasts appearing top-right stack with no gap and occasionally cover pagination controls. anyone seen this?

Ben Cho: saw that when testing narrow widths. ghost buttons use a 1px border + smaller vertical padding; icon buttons are center-aligned, so the baselines differ.

Maya R.: token drift. table ghost uses `--rwd-ghost-pad-compact` but our button baseline token is `--rwd-button-vertical` (space-2). leftover legacy selectors.

Iris Valdez: repro: Console > Resources > table row actions (ghost "Details") vs icon button (ellipsis). Trigger two toasts in succession (top-right) and watch pagination area. pagination arrows get covered by stacked toasts.

Ben Cho: code snippet from storybook:
```css
.btn-ghost { padding: var(--rwd-ghost-pad-compact); border-width: 1px; }
.icon-btn { padding: var(--rwd-icon-pad); }
.toast { top: 16px; right: 16px; margin-top: 0; }
.toast + .toast { margin-top: 0; }
```

Maya R.: proposals:
- align ghost/button vertical padding to `--rwd-button-vertical` (explicit token)
- introduce `--rwd-toast-stack-gap` default `8px` so stacked toasts don't overlap interactive chrome (pagination)
- add `--rwd-component-baseline` token so inline elements align to same baseline (helps icons + text)

Iris Valdez: accessibility note: ensure ghost buttons keep min hit target (44x44) when we increase padding. also focus ring offset should be consistent (recommend 3px) across ghosts, icons, and pill actions.

Ben Cho: agree. we should avoid increasing z-index of toasts; reserve safe spacing near pagination and tables when toasts present. maybe table wrapper can apply `padding-top: var(--rwd-toast-stack-safe)` when a toast container is non-empty.

DesignBot: Snapshot test queued for branch `ux/ghost-baseline-toast-gap` (PR #4731) 2:11:02  visual-regression + a11y-lint.

Maya R.: small copy nit: ghost action label is "View details" vs icon tooltip "More". let's keep ghost concise — "Details" — and align tooltips to full label when helpful. documenting in Buttons -> Inline vs Icon guidance.

Iris Valdez: good call. I'll add a combined story (table row + icon + toast stack + pagination) to visual tests so regressions show up.

Ben Cho: implementation note: switch table selectors to rely on `.rwd-button` class with tokens instead of per-component overrides. reduces token drift.

Ops-Bot: CI: PR #4731 built. Visual diffs: stories updated (buttons/ghost-baseline, table/pagination-with-toasts, toast/stack-gap). a11y-lint: 0 failures, 1 advisory (focus contrast on low-contrast theme) assigned to Maya.

Maya R.: I'll fix the focus color to `--rwd-focus-strong` across themes and push a patch.

Iris Valdez: assigning PR to @Ben for CSS changes and @Maya for a11y fixes. thanks!

DesignBot: PR #4731 merged to staging. Changed stories: buttons/ghost-baseline, table/pagination-with-toasts, toast/stack-gap. CI: visual-regression passed.
